question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party and military underpins the strong trader consensus against his removal before 2027. At age 73, he faces no formal term limits or visible internal opposition, while ongoing anti-corruption purges—including recent removals from the Central Military Commission—have reinforced loyalty networks and eliminated potential rivals ahead of the 21st Party Congress. That congress, expected in late 2027, is widely anticipated to endorse a fourth term extending his leadership at least through 2032, consistent with patterns of elite management that defer succession questions. Realistic shifts remain possible only through low-probability events such as acute health developments or abrupt factional realignments capable of disrupting the current power structure.
